title: Salon booking with services, slots and admin
describe: a salon booking app with services, time slots and an admin page
prompt:
Build a booking app for a small salon, with no server.

Requirements:
- /: a heading "Book a visit" and three services, hard-coded: Haircut (45 min, $40), Colour (90 min, $120) and Beard trim (20 min, $20). Each has a button "Book <service>", for example "Book Haircut".
- Choosing a service shows the time slots 10:00, 11:00 and 14:00 as buttons. Choosing a slot shows a field labelled "Your name" and a button "Confirm booking".
- Confirming shows "Booked: <service> at <time>". A booked slot cannot be booked again for the same service: its button is disabled.
- /admin: a heading "Bookings" and a table of bookings with name, service and time, each row with a button "Cancel booking". With no bookings it shows "No bookings".
- Bookings are kept in the browser (local storage) so /admin sees what / saved.
